evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: search/discovery; 'content identification or fingerprinting' are alternative implementation techniques, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Single feature (profile-based discovery).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Single feature (collaborative discovery).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single discovery feature; 'music or ringback tones' are content types/variants of the same feature, not distinct requirements.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Single search/discovery feature; metadata and image tags are inputs/attributes, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Single upload+propagation workflow: tag-aware upload and making tags available are part of one upload-processing feature rather than two independent features.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing thumbnail sequences.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: obtaining info about similar content at item or segment granularity (attributes of same feature).

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature focused on perceptual similarity; item vs segment are granularities, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Single recommendation feature (profile-based).

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Single recommendation feature using news-event context.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines two independently implementable/testable features: person identification and retrieval/presentation of related information.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Two separable features: product detection and enrichment (retrieving related info); each can be implemented/tested independently.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines detection (logos) and retrieval/presentation of related information — independent features.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Separates brand identification from enrichment/related-info retrieval; these are independently implementable/testable.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: image-based recommendation; 'take or upload' are input alternatives, not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest
evaluations.rationale: Single geo-based discovery feature; elements (map access, being informed) are parts of one feature.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ASR-based search.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Contains three independently implementable/testable actions (view, validate, edit); these can be prioritized or delivered separately.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Combines annotation (human/UX feature) and automated topic extraction (separate processing feature); independently implementable.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Contains two distinct functions (filtering and ranking) that can be implemented/tested/prioritized independently.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Single detection/assessment feature.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Single prefiltering feature.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Single prefilter/search feature using low-level asset info.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Single automated validation feature (copyright checking).

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Single prefiltering/search feature using high-level asset info; metadata/tags are inputs, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Single assessment feature; multiple data sources are attributes of the same feature, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Single detection/notification feature using multiple inputs.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Single classification feature.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Single preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Single image-series-detection feature for a specific case.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single attribute preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature (counting animals).

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Single segmentation/localization feature; 'or' indicates alternative approaches for same goal.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature where 'size or orientation' are attributes to detect, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single species preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Single motion-analysis feature with a specific goal (reduce duration).

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Single detection/timestamping feature.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect important features; enumerated feature types are instances/attributes of the same detection capability.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Single assessment/weighting feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Single prefiltering feature; examples of artefacts are attributes, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature covering moving/transient objects (closely related targets within one feature).

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Single audio-cleaning feature (noise and distractions are aspects of same feature).

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Single clustering/grouping feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Single counting/detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single decision/detection feature for interruption timing.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single decision feature to choose interruption medium; listed media are options/outputs of that one decision.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single decision/notification feature (when to educate).

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single decision feature to choose education medium; options are attributes of that decision.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single selection/recommendation feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single detection/flagging feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single timing/trigger decision feature for Zoonibot commenting.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Single decision/trigger feature (when to explain).

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single content-selection feature for Zoonibot utterances.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single grouping/clustering feature.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Single recommendation feature (project suggestions based on history).

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Single summarization feature for article reuse.
